topic: What beam switching strategies minimize setup times while maintaining spectrum efficiency for multi-satellite ground station operations?
consensus_response: Adaptive beam switching with phased array antennas and ACM optimizes spectrum efficiency by dynamically adjusting beamforming patterns and modulation schemes to match heterogeneous traffic density, reducing inter-beam interference and increasing system capacity.
reference_context: Multibeam antenna technology enables spectrum reuse, while adaptive resource allocation manages inter-cell interference, enhancing system performance.
